items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: From Freddie Capel, Lowe Armstrong, and all them little... I know some of them.

ctx.x: What's the most bands you've ever seen in the funeral?

We had the old Ricker, all right, had the tuxedas. Had the old Ricker, they had the tuxedas, they had the hornwoods. That's only three bands they ever had. Tuxedas and the hornwoods and the Excelsons. That's only bands they had. That's only bands they had. That's only bands they had. I tried that they didn't have no more bands. But all of them, all of them little, you know what I'm talking about, them little boy, them little musicians wants to be a musician, you understand? Loining, well like that, but I'm…
Do you remember the Robichaud band? Yeah. But I never did know the violin player.
